My code is well-tested. Now, I'm working to consolidate all the logic for DB02 within `sap_automator.py`, to streamline and simplify code readability.

"# Implementation Plan - DB02 Overview Navigation & Screenshots

This plan implements the "Second Logic" for the `DB02` transaction code database administration view in SAP WebGUI. It handles expanding the "Current Status" folder, double-clicking "Overview", and capturing three distinct screenshots: the initial overview screen, scrolled down, and scrolled right at the bottom.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - These changes are fully isolated within the `if tcode == "DB02":` block in `sap_automator.py` and the `DB02` special processing block in `report_generator.py` and `orchestrator.py`, preventing any side effects on other transaction codes like `SM21`, `ST22`, or others.
> - The labels for the three additional screenshots in the final report will be changed from `["Performance", "Current Status"]` to `["Overview - Initial", "Overview - Scrolled Down", "Overview - Scrolled Right"]`.

## Proposed Changes

### SAP Automator

#### [MODIFY] [sap_automator.py](file:///Users/giri/Antigravity/sap_monitoring/backend/sap_automator.py)
- Replace the simple single-screenshot logic for `DB02` with the tree navigation flow:
  1. Capture the default/initial screen (showing "Missing Database Indexes") and store it as the primary `DB02` screenshot.
  2. Scan page frames to find the frame containing the tree navigation structure (containing "Current Status" and "Diagnostics" or "Performance").
  3. Locate the tree nodes for "Current Status" and "Overview" and click them using mouse event dispatches (`mousedown`, `mouseup`, `click`, `dblclick`) on the parent tree node element container to expand the folder and select the node.
  4. Wait for the Overview page to render, then capture the **initial** overview screenshot.
  5. Scroll all frames down to the bottom and capture the **scrolled down** screenshot.
  6. Scroll all frames right at the bottom and capture the **scrolled right** screenshot.
